sentences.en: Jacob loved Joseph and made him a coat of many colors
sentences.pt: Jacó amava José e lhe fez uma túnica de muitas cores

sentences.en: A coat of many colors
sentences.pt: Uma túnica de muitas cores

sentences.en: Joseph had a dream
sentences.pt: José teve um sonho

sentences.en: Your sheaves bowed down to my sheaf
sentences.pt: Os vossos molhos se inclinaram ao meu molho

sentences.en: The sun, the moon and eleven stars bowed to me
sentences.pt: O sol, a lua e onze estrelas se inclinaram a mim

sentences.en: His brothers were full of envy
sentences.pt: Os seus irmãos estavam cheios de inveja

sentences.en: The brothers hated Joseph because of his dreams
sentences.pt: Os irmãos odiavam José por causa dos seus sonhos

sentences.en: They cast him into a pit
sentences.pt: Eles o lançaram numa cova

sentences.en: The pit was empty; there was no water in it
sentences.pt: A cova estava vazia, não havia água nela

sentences.en: His brothers sold him
sentences.pt: Os irmãos dele o venderam

sentences.en: They sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver
alt: They sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver
sentences.pt: Venderam José por vinte moedas de prata aos ismaelitas

sentences.en: They sold him for silver
sentences.pt: Eles o venderam por prata

verse.text: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren.
verse.pt: Teve José um sonho, que contou a seus irmãos.

reading.text: Joseph was seventeen years old. He kept the flock with his brothers. His father loved him and made him a coat of many colors. His brothers saw it and hated him.
reading.pt: José tinha dezessete anos. Ele apascentava o rebanho com os seus irmãos. O seu pai o amava e lhe fez uma túnica de muitas cores. Os irmãos viram isso e o odiaram.

options: The sun and the moon bowed to me.
dialogue.answer: The sun and the moon bowed to me.
dialogue.answerPt: O sol e a lua se curvaram diante de mim.

quiz.q: To whom did the brothers sell Joseph?
quiz.explain: Os irmãos venderam José por vinte moedas de prata aos ismaelitas, que o levaram ao Egito (Gênesis 37:28).

sentences.en: Joseph was a servant in Potiphar's house
sentences.pt: José era servo na casa de Potifar

sentences.en: Potiphar was angry and put Joseph in prison
sentences.pt: Potifar se irou e pôs José na prisão

sentences.en: Joseph was in prison
sentences.pt: José estava na prisão

sentences.en: The Lord was with Joseph in the prison
sentences.pt: O Senhor estava com José na prisão

sentences.en: The butler and the baker had dreams
sentences.pt: O copeiro e o padeiro tiveram sonhos

sentences.en: Joseph interpreted the dream
sentences.pt: José interpretou o sonho

sentences.en: Do not interpretations belong to God?
sentences.pt: Não são de Deus as interpretações?

sentences.en: The butler forgot Joseph for two years
sentences.pt: O copeiro se esqueceu de José por dois anos

sentences.en: Pharaoh dreamed of seven fat cows and seven thin cows
sentences.pt: Faraó sonhou com sete vacas gordas e sete vacas magras

sentences.en: Seven years of plenty
sentences.pt: Sete anos de fartura

sentences.en: Then seven years of famine will come
sentences.pt: Depois virão sete anos de fome

sentences.en: Pharaoh made Joseph ruler over all the land of Egypt
sentences.pt: Faraó pôs José por governador sobre toda a terra do Egito

verse.text: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy.
verse.pt: O Senhor, porém, estava com José e estendeu sobre ele a sua benignidade.

reading.text: In the prison, the butler and the baker had dreams. Joseph interpreted them. After two years, Pharaoh dreamed of seven fat cows and seven thin cows. The butler remembered Joseph, and Pharaoh called him.
reading.pt: Na prisão, o copeiro e o padeiro tiveram sonhos. José os interpretou. Depois de dois anos, Faraó sonhou com sete vacas gordas e sete vacas magras. O copeiro se lembrou de José, e Faraó o chamou.

dialogue.pt: Você pode interpretar o meu sonho?

quiz.q: How many years of plenty did Joseph announce?
quiz.explain: Sete anos de grande fartura e depois sete anos de fome (Gênesis 41:29-30).

sentences.en: The brothers went to Egypt to buy grain
sentences.pt: Os irmãos desceram ao Egito para comprar trigo

sentences.en: Joseph put the money back in their sacks
sentences.pt: José pôs o dinheiro de volta nos sacos deles

sentences.en: Joseph put his silver cup in the sack of Benjamin
sentences.pt: José pôs o seu copo de prata no saco de Benjamim

sentences.en: Joseph wept
sentences.pt: José chorou

sentences.en: I am Joseph, your brother
sentences.pt: Eu sou José, o irmão de vocês

sentences.en: I am Joseph; is my father still alive?
sentences.pt: Eu sou José; vive ainda meu pai?

sentences.en: Joseph fell on the neck of his brother Benjamin and wept
sentences.pt: José se lançou ao pescoço de Benjamim, seu irmão, e chorou

sentences.en: Joseph forgave his brothers
sentences.pt: José perdoou os seus irmãos

sentences.en: Joseph my son is still alive; I will go and see him
sentences.pt: José, meu filho, ainda vive; eu irei e o verei

sentences.en: Jacob and all his family went down to Egypt
sentences.pt: Jacó e toda a sua família desceram ao Egito

sentences.en: You thought evil against me, but God meant it for good
sentences.pt: Vós intentastes mal contra mim, porém Deus o tornou em bem

sentences.en: Forgive now the trespass of your brothers
sentences.pt: Perdoa, pois, agora a transgressão dos teus irmãos

verse.text: Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.
verse.pt: Vós bem intentastes mal contra mim, porém Deus o tornou em bem.

reading.text: The brothers came to Egypt and bowed down before Joseph. Joseph knew them, but they did not know him. At last he said: I am Joseph. God sent me before you to preserve life.
reading.pt: Os irmãos vieram ao Egito e se inclinaram diante de José. José os reconheceu, mas eles não o reconheceram. Por fim ele disse: Eu sou José. Deus me enviou adiante de vós para conservar a vida.
options: No, they did not know him
reading.answer: No, they did not know him

dialogue.line: We are your brothers. Forgive us!
options: Do not be afraid. God meant it for good.
dialogue.answer: Do not be afraid. God meant it for good.
dialogue.answerPt: Não tenham medo. Deus o tornou em bem.

quiz.q: What did Joseph put in Benjamin's sack?
quiz.explain: José mandou pôr o seu copo de prata na boca do saco de Benjamim (Gênesis 44:2).
